taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-23, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 994.7 | 15.91 | 15.91
2 | 1719.5 | 4.88 | 20.79
3 | 7929.4 | 21.88 | 42.67
4 | 8125.6 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve type for station T-23, we first list the resistivities of the layers in order:
1. $r_1 = 994.7\ \Omega\text{-m}$
2. $r_2 = 1719.5\ \Omega\text{-m}$
3. $r_3 = 7929.4\ \Omega\text{-m}$
4. $r_4 = 8125.6\ \Omega\text{-m}$

Next, we examine each group of three consecutive layers to assign the corresponding letter:
- **Group 1 (Layers 1-2-3):** $r_1 = 994.7$, $r_2 = 1719.5$, $r_3 = 7929.4$. Since $994.7 < 1719.5 < 7929.4$ ($r_1 < r_2 < r_3$), the letter is **A**.
- **Group 2 (Layers 2-3-4):** $r_2 = 1719.5$, $r_3 = 7929.4$, $r_4 = 8125.6$. Since $1719.5 < 7929.4 < 8125.6$ ($r_2 < r_3 < r_4$), the letter is **A**.

The sequence of letters is **AA**. According to the instructions, if all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter.

{"curve_type": "A"}
